_comment: config/relations.json for data from `hakken.py fetch-pubtator` (PubTator3 / BioREx relation types).

definitions.ASSOCIATION: subject and object are reported as related (no direction or polarity stated)
definitions.POSITIVE_CORRELATION: increase or activation of subject goes with increase or activation of object
definitions.NEGATIVE_CORRELATION: increase or activation of subject goes with decrease or inhibition of object
definitions.COTREATMENT: subject and object are administered together
definitions.DRUG_INTERACTION: subject and object interact as drugs
